claim_text: Dataset contains 30 African candidate sites with renewable and distance features
Base-case delivered African hydrogen costs are materially above the stylized Europe benchmark by 2030
De-risking lowers African delivered cost relative to base high-risk financing
A high-rate environment raises both African delivered costs and the Europe benchmark
The lowest-cost sites in this sample are concentrated in Namibia/Botswana-adjacent southern African locations
None of the 30 sampled African sites beats the stylized Europe benchmark in the modeled scenarios
Financing assumptions strongly shift the cost distribution
This implementation is transparent but simplified relative to full GeoH2-style temporal optimization
